title: cacalia chamaepeuces
intro: Cacalia chamaepeuces, commonly known as Golden Cacalia, is a plant species belonging to the Asteraceae family, typically found in China. It is valued for its numerous health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immunomodulatory properties, which can help to protect against chronic diseases such as cardiovascular disease and cancer. The therapeutic actions of Golden Cacalia include its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antitumor activity. The bioactive constituents of Cacalia chamaepeuces include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
